items.minimumFixScope: Update package.json exports and the README/API examples for speckit, bmad, generic, and file-discovery utilities.

items.title: BMAD conversion collects path errors and warnings but always returns a successful plan
items.recommendation: Change bmadToAPS to return conversion diagnostics alongside the plan, or throw/return a failed ParseResult when errors are collected. At minimum, propagate warnings such as NO_CHANGES to ParseResult.warnings and treat invalid paths as parse errors unless a documented partial-conversion mode is requested.
items.reproduction: Parse a structured BMAD agent YAML whose menu item has `exec: /etc/shadow` or `exec: ../../outside.md`. safePath rejects it, bmadToAPS pushes INVALID_PATH, then returns an APSPlan; BMADFormatAdapter.parse wraps it in createParseSuccess without exposing the error.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included BMAD tests check that malformed content does not throw and that requirement ID traversal does not appear in resulting paths, but they do not assert that collected INVALID_PATH errors or NO_CHANGES warnings are surfaced to callers.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a BMAD agent/workflow YAML fixture with an invalid absolute or traversal path and assert adapter.parse returns success false with an INVALID_PATH error, or returns success true only when partial mode is enabled and includes the warning/error diagnostics.
items.minimumFixScope: Refactor BMADFormatAdapter.parse and bmadToAPS so conversion diagnostics are part of the ParseResult contract rather than discarded local arrays.

items.title: Device activation submits a legacy unauthenticated payload
items.recommendation: Update the activation flow to authenticate the user before confirming, then call the API with the expected Authorization credential and only the fields accepted by the confirm contract. Remove the body-supplied email from the confirm request unless it is part of a separate sign-in step.
items.reproduction: Open /auth/activate, enter any email and code, and submit against the current API. The request body contains userCode/email only and no bearer credential, so the API rejects it before confirmation.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests are listed for this website app source group, and there is no component or integration test asserting the activation page request shape against the device-confirm API contract.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a website test for /auth/activate that stubs fetch and verifies the confirm request includes the required Authorization credential and does not include email in the confirm body; add an integration test that exercises the page against the API route contract.
items.minimumFixScope: apps/website/app/auth/activate/page.tsx and any supporting auth/session wiring needed for the device activation page.

items.title: Security page publishes a placeholder PGP fingerprint
items.recommendation: Replace the placeholder with the actual PGP fingerprint or remove the PGP section until the public key and fingerprint are published. Prefer linking the .well-known key URL directly and adding a test or content check that rejects placeholder fingerprints.
items.reproduction: Visit /security and read the PGP KEY section; the displayed fingerprint is not a real fingerprint.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests are listed for this website app source group, and there is no content regression check for placeholder security contact material.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a content test for the security page that asserts the PGP fingerprint matches a real fingerprint format and does not contain placeholder tokens such as XXXX.
items.minimumFixScope: apps/website/app/security/page.tsx and the public key publishing path if the advertised .well-known file is not already deployed.

items.title: domainImports validation does not ensure the import ID matches the domain being adopted
items.recommendation: Parse the import ID after the optional team/project prefix and require the remaining domain segment to equal the domainImports key. Reject IDs with mismatched or empty domain suffixes before creating ProjectDomain resources.
items.reproduction: Create a VercelApp with domains ["www.example.com"] and domainImports {"www.example.com":"prj_test123abc/example.com"}; construction succeeds even though the import ID identifies example.com rather than www.example.com.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: Existing tests cover keys absent from domains, malformed IDs, and team-prefixed IDs, but not a well-formed ID whose embedded domain differs from the map key.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a domainImports test that expects {"www.example.com":"prj_test123abc/example.com"} to throw with a domain mismatch error.
items.minimumFixScope: VercelApp domainImports validation and the domainImports test block.

items.title: Default Vercel ignore command interpolates path arguments into a shell string
items.recommendation: Validate rootDirectory and extraWatchPaths with the same kind of allow-list used for productionBranch, or centralise shell argument quoting for every generated argument including the git toplevel cd target. Add negative tests for metacharacters in rootDirectory and extraWatchPaths.
items.reproduction: Instantiate VercelApp with rootDirectory set to "apps/web; echo injected" or an extraWatchPaths entry containing a single quote and shell syntax, then inspect the Project ignoreCommand registered by Pulumi mocks.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The tests cover shell metacharacter rejection for productionBranch only; all rootDirectory and extraWatchPaths examples use simple safe paths.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add VercelApp tests asserting rootDirectory and extraWatchPaths values with shell metacharacters are rejected, plus a positive test for ordinary nested paths.
items.minimumFixScope: VercelApp defaultIgnoreCommand construction and its component tests.

items.title: Generated no-orphans dependency-cruiser rule forbids normal dependencies
items.recommendation: Generate the orphan rule with the dependency-cruiser orphan selector, for example from: { orphan: true, pathNot: [...] }, and add an assertion on the emitted rule shape.
items.reproduction: Generate a config with detect_orphans true and run dependency-cruiser on any non-excluded file that imports another file; the no-orphans forbidden rule applies without checking orphan status.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The existing orphan test only checks that the rule exists and carries the configured severity. It does not parse the rule shape or execute dependency-cruiser against a fixture with a normal import.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Parse generateDCConfig output and assert the no-orphans rule includes orphan: true; optionally add a small dependency-cruiser fixture where a normal imported module does not trigger no-orphans.
items.minimumFixScope: packages/anvil/core/src/architecture/dc-generator.ts and dc-generator tests.

items.title: includeTests=false only hides test entry points, not test files
items.recommendation: When includeTests is false, exclude common test paths in filterFiles before analysis, or clarify the option name/API if it is intended to affect only entry point classification.
items.reproduction: Analyse ['src/index.ts', 'src/services/user.service.test.ts'] with default options. entryPoints excludes the test, but moduleCount is still 2 and the test file is still passed to layer and violation analysis.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The existing tests only assert that test entry point types are filtered. They do not assert moduleCount, assignments, or violations for test files when includeTests is false.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add an analyser test that passes a test file and a non-test file with default options and asserts moduleCount, assignments, and violation extraction exclude the test file; add the inverse assertion for includeTests: true.
items.minimumFixScope: packages/anvil/core/src/architecture/analyzer.ts plus analyser tests.

items.title: Extension-specific layer patterns miss TypeScript imports written with .js specifiers
items.recommendation: Resolve import targets against the analysed file set before layer detection, including extension aliases such as .js -> .ts/.tsx and index resolution, while preserving the original specifier for reporting.
items.reproduction: Use layers { presentation: { patterns: ['src/presentation/**/*.ts'], depends_on: [] }, infrastructure: { patterns: ['src/infrastructure/**/*.ts'], depends_on: [] } } and a file src/presentation/handler.ts importing '../infrastructure/repo.js'. The target layer is not detected and no boundary violation is reported.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The tests verify that .js specifiers are preserved by resolveImportPath and separately verify .ts layer regex generation, but no test exercises boundary detection with extension-specific layer patterns and TypeScript .js import specifiers.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add an ArchitectureAnalyser violation test with extension-specific custom layers and a .ts source importing a sibling layer via a .js specifier, expecting one new violation.
items.minimumFixScope: Import target resolution in packages/anvil/core/src/architecture/edge-detector.ts or target normalisation in packages/anvil/core/src/architecture/analyzer.ts, plus analyser tests.

items.title: Entry point detection misses package.json string exports
items.recommendation: Handle typeof pkg.exports === 'string' before object recursion and return a package entry for matching paths. Keep object recursion for subpath and conditional exports.
items.reproduction: Create package.json with { "name": "pkg", "exports": "./dist/index.js" } and call detectEntryPoint('dist/index.js'). It returns null.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The exports test only covers object-shaped exports and does not include the valid top-level string export form.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add an EntryPointDetector test for package.json exports as a string and assert dist/index.js is detected as a package entry.
items.minimumFixScope: packages/anvil/core/src/architecture/entry-detector.ts and entry-detector tests.

items.title: Exact planning-file matches never receive the intended high-confidence score
items.recommendation: Evaluate exact-name matches against basename(filename). Keep path-based directory boosts separate so docs/.anvil confidence still works.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included associated tests cover AdapterRegistry only; no file-discovery test asserts confidence ordering for exact filenames versus partial pattern filenames.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Create a temp tree containing plan.md and implementation-plan.md with implementation-plan.md newer, then assert findBestPlanningFile returns plan.md because the exact match receives higher confidence.
items.minimumFixScope: packages/adapters/src/base/file-discovery.ts and a new file-discovery test covering confidence ranking.

items.title: resetInstance creates a new singleton while the exported registry still points at the old instance
items.recommendation: Avoid exporting a stale captured singleton, or make reset semantics update/clear the same exported object. If both APIs must remain, document the split and add tests that define the expected behaviour.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The registry tests assert resetInstance creates a distinct getInstance result, but they never import or compare the exported registry constant after reset.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Import registry and AdapterRegistry, call AdapterRegistry.resetInstance(), then assert the intended contract: either registry === AdapterRegistry.getInstance() or registry is explicitly documented and tested as a legacy fixed instance.
items.minimumFixScope: packages/adapters/src/base/registry.ts plus registry API tests.

items.title: countOccurrences treats literal strings as regular expressions and drops RegExp flags
items.recommendation: For string patterns, count literal occurrences with indexOf/split or escape the string before constructing a RegExp. For RegExp patterns, preserve existing flags while adding 'g' when absent, and avoid mutating caller-owned regex state.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The linked registry test only exercises registry behaviour and createDetection; there are no included tests for utils.ts or literal/flagged countOccurrences inputs.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add tests asserting countOccurrences('a.c.', '.') === 2, countOccurrences('abc', '[') does not throw and returns 0, and countOccurrences('Foo foo', /foo/i) === 2.
items.minimumFixScope: packages/adapters/src/base/utils.ts plus focused utility tests.

items.title: Invalid BMAD YAML paths are recorded then silently discarded
items.recommendation: Make path-conversion errors observable: either throw when errors.length > 0 so BMADFormatAdapter.parse returns a parse error, or extend the parse result path to include warnings/errors while clearly marking the conversion partial.
items.reproduction: Parse an agent YAML document with a valid metadata block plus a menu item such as exec: "../outside.md". The invalid menu change is omitted and parse still succeeds because the collected INVALID_PATH error is not surfaced.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests cover generic parser and serializer behaviour only; they do not exercise BMAD YAML path validation or assert that conversion errors are returned to callers.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a BMAD adapter test with an invalid agent menu exec/workflow path and assert the parse result is unsuccessful, or assert it contains an explicit partial-conversion warning/error if partial success is the intended contract.
items.minimumFixScope: .claude/worktrees/feat+usage-002/packages/adapters/src/bmad/parser.ts and the adapter parse-result handling needed to expose collected errors.

items.title: BMAD size guard can be bypassed with multi-byte input
items.recommendation: Use Buffer.byteLength(content, 'utf8') for the BMAD input-size check, mirroring the generic parser behaviour.
items.reproduction: Call parseBMADDocument('\u{1F600}'.repeat(Math.floor((2 * 1024 * 1024) / 4) + 1)); Buffer.byteLength exceeds 2MiB, but content.length is below the limit so the guard does not throw.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included byte-limit regression tests exercise parseGeneric only; no included test calls parseBMADDocument or BMADFormatAdapter.parse with multi-byte oversized content.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a BMAD parser test that builds emoji content whose UTF-8 byte length exceeds MAX_INPUT_SIZE while content.length does not, and assert parseBMADDocument throws the maximum size error.
items.minimumFixScope: .claude/worktrees/feat+usage-002/packages/adapters/src/bmad/parser.ts plus a BMAD parser regression test.

items.title: BMAD barrel type-only exports runtime enums
items.recommendation: Export the enums as values from the barrel, for example export { BMAD_FOLDERS, BMAD_UPSTREAM_VERSION, BMADDocumentType, RequirementType } from './types.js', while keeping interfaces in the type-only export block.
items.reproduction: Import { BMADDocumentType } from './bmad/index.js' and use BMADDocumentType.PRD in TypeScript. The symbol is type-only from the barrel and is unavailable as a runtime value.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests do not import BMADDocumentType or RequirementType through the BMAD barrel or package public entrypoint.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a public API test that imports BMADDocumentType and RequirementType from the BMAD index and asserts their runtime members are available.
items.minimumFixScope: .claude/worktrees/feat+usage-002/packages/adapters/src/bmad/index.ts plus a barrel export regression test.

items.title: Skipping task-format disables unrelated task-content rules
items.recommendation: Separate task heading validation from task content validation, or always collect task sections and run validateTaskContent unless its own rule names are skipped.
items.reproduction: Call validatePlanningDoc on a leaf spec containing a task without Intent using { recursive: false, skipRules: ['task-format'] }. No task-intent error is emitted because validateTaskFormat is never called.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The existing skipRules test skips task-intent and missing-confidence directly, but there is no test asserting that skipping task-format still preserves task-intent and missing-* checks.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a fixture with a missing Intent field and assert validatePlanningDoc(fixture, { recursive: false, skipRules: ['task-format'] }) still reports a task-intent error.
items.minimumFixScope: Refactor validator task traversal so task-content rules are not gated by the task-format skip rule.

items.title: Task heading validation accepts empty titles
items.recommendation: Require at least one non-whitespace title character in the task-format regex, for example /^([A-Z0-9]+-\d+):\s*(\S.*)$/ after trimming extracted heading text.
items.reproduction: Validate a leaf spec with '### ABC-001:' and all required fields using { recursive: false }. The task-format rule will not report an error for the missing title.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The task-format tests cover lowercase IDs, wrong numeric width, and long scopes, but not an otherwise well-formed ID with an empty title.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a fixture containing '### TEST-001:' with valid fields and assert a task-format error is emitted.
items.minimumFixScope: Tighten the task heading regex and add one validator fixture/test for empty titles.

items.title: Concurrent locks for different tasks can overwrite each other in state.json
items.recommendation: Serialise all state.json updates with a project-wide state lock, or implement an atomic compare-and-retry merge around readStateFile/writeStateFile so concurrent updates preserve existing task entries.
items.reproduction: Create two TaskLocker instances for the same project root and run Promise.all([locker1.lock('TEST-001'), locker2.lock('TEST-002')]) against a plan containing both tasks. Depending on timing, .anvil/state.json can contain only one of the two locked task records.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The tests assert that concurrent lock attempts for the same task have one winner, but there is no test for successful concurrent locks of different tasks updating the shared state file.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a TaskLocker test that concurrently locks TEST-001 and TEST-002, asserts both calls succeed, then reads state.json and verifies both task records are present with locked status.
items.minimumFixScope: State file update path in src/state/index.ts plus one concurrent different-task regression test.

items.title: Root index detection accepts headings that parseIndex does not parse
items.recommendation: Use one shared section-title predicate for detection, validation, and parseIndex. If variants are supported, parseIndex should accept the same variants; if not, detectIndexFile should require the exact canonical heading and handle false-positive root files the same way nested probing does.
items.reproduction: Call loadPlan on a leaf file whose H2 sections include '## Modules impacted' and '## Tasks'. detectIndexFile returns true, parseIndex sees no exact 'modules' section, and the loaded plan has no tasks.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The loader test proves nested false positives are handled after probing linked modules, but it does not cover a root document with a 'Modules impacted' heading or a supported variant such as 'Modules & Scopes'.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add root-level loadPlan cases for a leaf file with '## Modules impacted' and an index file using the accepted variant heading, then assert tasks/modules are loaded as intended.
items.minimumFixScope: Shared module-section detection/parsing logic in loader, validator, and parse-index, plus focused root detection tests.

items.title: generate-templates omits the actions template from generated files
items.recommendation: Write templates.actions to actions-template.md and include it in the script's console output. Consider deriving the file list from TemplateBundle keys to avoid future omissions.
items.reproduction: Run node scripts/generate-templates.js /tmp/aps-templates after building; /tmp/aps-templates contains index-template.md, leaf-template.md, and simple-template.md, but no actions-template.md.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The generator tests exercise in-memory template functions only; no included test executes scripts/generate-templates.js or checks the output directory contents.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a script smoke test that runs generate-templates.js against a temporary directory and asserts index-template.md, leaf-template.md, simple-template.md, and actions-template.md all exist and are non-empty.
items.minimumFixScope: scripts/generate-templates.js plus one script-level regression test.

items.title: Configured publish root makes package exports resolve to dist/dist paths
items.recommendation: Make the publish root and manifest paths agree. Either publish from the project root with ./dist/* exports, or generate/copy a dist/package.json whose main/types/exports point to ./index.js, ./parser/index.js, and the other files relative to dist.
items.reproduction: Build the package, prepare the configured release packageRoot, then pack or import from that root. The package manifest either is missing or its main/export paths point one directory too deep.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests import source modules and do not build, pack, or resolve the package from the configured nx-release-publish packageRoot.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a packaging smoke test that builds @eddacraft/anvil-aps, packs the configured packageRoot, extracts it into a temp project, and imports the root plus every exported subpath.
items.minimumFixScope: package.json/project.json release configuration or package preparation step, plus a package artifact smoke test.

items.title: Default test command excludes root package script regressions
items.recommendation: Either include the root script regression suites in the default validation path, or document and enforce a separate CI target that always runs them for changes under `scripts/aps/**`, `scripts/docs/**`, and related root package files.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The feature declares no linked tests, and the manifest shows the relevant script tests are separate from `pnpm test`.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a manifest or CI-contract test that verifies root governance-script tests are invoked by the standard validation path for changes to `scripts/aps/**` and `scripts/docs/**`.
items.minimumFixScope: `package.json` test script composition or the CI change-classification contract that selects the root script test suites.

items.title: Baseline regeneration can erase existing entries when a surface fails before JSON output
items.recommendation: Collect all baselineable surface outputs first, treat invocation/no-output/invalid-JSON failures as fatal, and only replace the baseline after every required surface has parsed successfully. Prefer writing to a temporary file and renaming after successful generation.
items.reproduction: Make one baselineable surface fail before emitting JSON, for example by temporarily breaking its import, then run `pnpm docs:check:update-baseline`; the command continues to the final write with that surface omitted from the new baseline.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided for this feature, and the included manifest only exposes `test:docs-check` as a separate script; there is no included evidence of a regression case where a baselineable surface fails during `--update-baseline`.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a docs-check update-baseline test that stubs one baselineable surface to emit no JSON or invalid JSON, asserts a non-zero exit, and asserts the existing baseline file is unchanged.
items.minimumFixScope: `scripts/docs/docs-check.mjs` baseline regeneration error handling and its docs-check test coverage.

items.title: Release date is inconsistent between README and changelog
items.recommendation: Choose the authoritative release date and update the other document to match; consider adding this date consistency to the docs closeout or release-readiness checks.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included docs-check surfaces validate metadata, tags, links, APS, and ADR integrity, but no included evidence shows a cross-document release-date consistency check.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a lightweight docs/release consistency check that compares the latest README release-status version/date against the matching top changelog entry.
items.minimumFixScope: `README.md` or `CHANGELOG.md`, plus optional docs-check coverage for release metadata consistency.

items.title: Repeated product tile link text is ambiguous for assistive navigation
items.recommendation: Make each link name unique, for example by rendering `Learn more about {title}` or adding an `aria-label` such as `Learn more about Anvil` while preserving the visual text if desired.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided for the docs-site home page, and typical unit or build tests would not catch accessible-name ambiguity unless an accessibility assertion is added.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a docs-site component/accessibility test that renders ProductTiles and asserts each product tile link has a unique accessible name including the product title.
items.minimumFixScope: Update ProductTile in apps/docs-site/src/pages/index.tsx to include the product title in the link's accessible name.

items.title: Early-access install endpoint has no regression coverage
items.recommendation: Add focused route-handler tests that mock `fetch` and assert each response status/body branch, especially invalid JSON, missing key, upstream failures, non-Edict tokens, and the successful install command.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The feature declares no linked tests, and the website package scripts expose build/lint/start/dev but no test target for this API route.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Create a Vitest suite for `app/api/early-access/install/route.ts` that constructs `Request` objects, stubs `global.fetch`, calls `POST`, and verifies status codes plus JSON payloads for every branch.
items.minimumFixScope: Add route-level tests and wire them into the website or workspace test target.

items.title: Website production build can pass with TypeScript errors
items.recommendation: Remove `typescript.ignoreBuildErrors: true`, or make the package/Nx build target depend on an explicit typecheck target so the production build path fails before deployment when type errors exist.
items.reproduction: Introduce a TypeScript error in a website route or component, then run `pnpm --filter @eddacraft/anvil-website build` or `nx build website`; `next build` is allowed to complete because `ignoreBuildErrors` is enabled.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests are included for this feature, and the build configuration itself currently permits the failure mode instead of asserting against it.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a CI/Nx configuration check that `website:build` depends on `website:typecheck`, or add a small config test that fails if `typescript.ignoreBuildErrors` remains enabled without a typecheck dependency.
items.minimumFixScope: Update the website Next/Nx build configuration and package scripts so every production build path enforces TypeScript correctness.

items.title: Published contract subpaths do not resolve to the ports barrel or documented port modules
items.recommendation: Add explicit exports for ./contracts/ports, ./contracts/ports/edda, ./contracts/ports/ember, and ./contracts/ports/kindling that point to the emitted index and .port files, or add matching source barrel files so the existing public subpaths resolve.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were supplied, and package subpath resolution is not exercised by these interface files.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: After building packages/edda-stack, add a package-level test that imports the public subpaths @eddacraft/anvil-edda-stack/contracts/ports and @eddacraft/anvil-edda-stack/contracts/ports/edda through Node/package exports and verifies TypeScript declaration resolution.
items.minimumFixScope: packages/edda-stack/package.json exports plus any matching barrel files needed to keep the public subpaths stable.

items.title: ResolveProposalInput allows promoted proposals without a memory link
items.recommendation: Model ResolveProposalInput as a discriminated union so promoted requires memory_id, while dismissed/expired do not accept or require it. Keep markPromoted and resolveProposal aligned on the same invariant.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were supplied, and this is a type-level contract weakness that would need compile-time or adapter contract tests to catch.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a tsd or typecheck fixture asserting that resolveProposal({ status: 'promoted' }) fails without memory_id and that dismissed/expired inputs remain valid.
items.minimumFixScope: packages/edda-stack/src/contracts/ports/ember.port.ts ResolveProposalInput type and any callers/adapters that construct promoted resolution inputs.

items.title: Template generation script drops the actions template
items.recommendation: Write templates.actions to actions-template.md and include it in the success log. Add a script-level test or integration test that runs the generator into a temp directory and verifies all TemplateBundle keys are emitted.
items.reproduction: Run the package generate-templates script. The output directory contains index-template.md, leaf-template.md, and simple-template.md, but no actions-template.md.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The tests cover in-memory generator functions, including actions, but do not execute scripts/generate-templates.js or assert generated files on disk.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a vitest test that builds or imports the script target into a temporary output directory and expects index-template.md, leaf-template.md, simple-template.md, and actions-template.md to exist.
items.minimumFixScope: generate-templates.js output list and one script integration regression test.

items.title: Module heading variants are detected as indexes but not parsed as module sections
items.recommendation: Use the same normalisation predicate in parseIndex that detectIndexFile and validator structure checks use, preferably by sharing a helper for module-section detection.
items.reproduction: Create an APS index with '# Plan', '## Modules & Scopes', and an H3 module entry. loadPlan detects it as an index, parseIndex leaves currentSection as root for that H2, and the returned plan has no modules.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The loader test covers lowercase 'modules' and a false-positive leaf heading, but there is no test for documented startsWith variants such as 'Modules & Scopes'.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add parseIndex/loadPlan coverage for an index headed '## Modules & Scopes' and assert its H3 module entries are loaded.
items.minimumFixScope: parse-index section classification plus parser/loader tests for supported module-heading variants.

items.title: Concurrent locks for different tasks can overwrite each other in state.json
items.recommendation: Serialise all state.json read-modify-write operations with a project-level state lock, or implement an atomic update helper that retries/merges against the latest state before rename. Use that helper from lock, unlock, complete, and direct updateTaskState callers.
items.reproduction: Start two TaskLocker instances against the same projectRoot and call lock('TEST-001') and lock('TEST-002') concurrently. Both lock files can be created, but .anvil/state.json may contain only one of the two task records after the last write wins.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included concurrency tests cover concurrent acquisition of the same task ID only. They do not exercise concurrent successful locks for different task IDs that write the shared state file.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a TaskLocker test that concurrently locks TEST-001 and TEST-002, asserts both operations succeed, and then asserts readStateFile(tempDir).tasks contains both locked records.
items.minimumFixScope: State module locking/update path for state.json writes plus a regression test for concurrent different-task locks.

items.title: Task ID filtering leaves unrelated modules in the filtered result
items.recommendation: After task-level filters, intersect filteredModules with the modules that contain the remaining filteredTasks, or clearly split the API into selected modules versus context modules if retaining all modules is intentional.
items.reproduction: Call filterPlan(systemEcommercePlan, { tasks: ['AUTH-001'] }). The tasks array is narrowed, but modules still contains all modules from the plan rather than only the module that owns AUTH-001.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The task filtering test asserts only the tasks array. It never asserts filtered.modules or the context bundle shape for a task-only filter.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Extend the task filtering test to assert filtered.modules.map(m => m.id) equals ['auth'] for AUTH-only task IDs, and add a context-bundle assertion that unrelated modules are omitted.
items.minimumFixScope: filterPlan task-filter branch and tests for module narrowing under task-only criteria.

items.title: Linked json-render tests are skipped by the declared test command
items.recommendation: Update the linked validation and CI coverage for this crate to run the feature-enabled Rust tests, for example cargo test -p eddacraft-tui --features json-render or cargo test --workspace --all-features where the broader feature set is acceptable.
items.reproduction: Run the linked command as written and compare it with a feature-enabled invocation such as cargo test -p eddacraft-tui --features json-render; the cfg-gated tests only execute in the latter case unless another build layer enables the feature.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The tests contain relevant assertions, including catalogue parity and terminal control-sequence sanitisation, but the crate-level cfg attributes remove the test bodies whenever json-render is not enabled.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add or update the Rust CI/test script so it has an explicit json-render feature test job, and fail the job if the expected json_render_specs and catalog_parity tests are not discovered.
items.minimumFixScope: Test command or CI configuration for eddacraft-tui json-render feature coverage; no library API change is required.

items.title: Cargo manifest changes are not considered when checking binding freshness
items.recommendation: Include Cargo.toml and other native build inputs that affect the .node output in the freshness comparison, or use Cargo's own dependency tracking output when available instead of a src/-only mtime scan.
items.reproduction: Build the native binding, edit crates/anvil-checks-napi/Cargo.toml in a way that changes the native build without touching src/, then run pnpm --filter @eddacraft/anvil-checks-native test. The guard only reads src/ mtimes and can allow the stale binding.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests cover the freshness guard, and the script has no fixture proving which build inputs should invalidate the binding.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a test fixture where Cargo.toml is newer than the .node file while src/ is older, and assert that check-binding-fresh.mjs fails with the rebuild message.
items.minimumFixScope: Extend crates/anvil-checks-napi/scripts/check-binding-fresh.mjs to compute the newest mtime across src/ and Cargo build inputs such as Cargo.toml, then add a targeted regression test.

items.title: Newest unrelated native artefact can mask a stale loaded binding
items.recommendation: Resolve the native artefact name for the current platform, or delegate to the generated loader to identify the loaded local binding, then compare only that file's mtime against the Rust sources. If multiple local .node files are intentionally supported, validate every candidate that could be loaded on the current platform rather than taking a global maximum.
items.reproduction: In crates/anvil-checks-napi, keep a stale current-platform .node file, add or touch a second non-current-platform .node file so it is newer than src/, then run pnpm --filter @eddacraft/anvil-checks-native test on the current platform. The pretest script compares against the newer unrelated file and does not fail.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests exercise check-binding-fresh.mjs, and the existing package test command only invokes it as a pretest side effect rather than testing multi-artefact freshness behaviour directly.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a Node test for check-binding-fresh.mjs that creates a temporary package directory with a stale current-platform .node, a newer unrelated .node, and newer src/lib.rs content, then asserts the guard exits non-zero.
items.minimumFixScope: Update crates/anvil-checks-napi/scripts/check-binding-fresh.mjs to select the relevant current-platform .node file before comparing mtimes, plus add focused tests for stale, missing, and multi-artefact cases.

items.title: QueryStatus serializes to an undocumented command name instead of the documented JSON-RPC method
items.recommendation: Do not expose QueryStatus through the serializable command-envelope enum unless the daemon accepts that wire shape. Either remove/split the variant from the serde wire enum, add a custom serde implementation that rejects command-envelope QueryStatus, or add an explicit supported route and tests for the `query-status` command form.
items.reproduction: Construct `IpcEnvelope::request("req", IpcCommand::QueryStatus)` and serialize it with serde_json; it produces a command-envelope frame containing `"command":"query-status"`, not a JSON-RPC frame with `"method":"query_status"`.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The test module covers list-sessions, unblock-cascade, unblock-worktree, and unknown commands, but has no test that serializes or deserializes IpcCommand::QueryStatus or checks it against the documented `query_status` JSON-RPC method contract.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a proto test asserting that QueryStatus cannot be serialized as a command-envelope frame, or, if command-envelope support is intended, add a round-trip test that pins `{"command":"query-status"}` and pair it with daemon routing coverage for that exact frame.
items.minimumFixScope: Adjust the QueryStatus representation in `crates/anvil-intercept-proto/src/lib.rs` and add a focused serialization/deserialization test for the chosen contract.

items.title: Concurrent task locks can overwrite each other in state.json
items.recommendation: Serialize state.json updates with a state-level lock or use an atomic compare-and-retry update that rereads and merges on conflict before rename. Keep per-task lock files for same-task exclusion, but protect writes to the shared state file separately.
items.reproduction: Start with an empty state file and two valid task IDs in the same plan. Run Promise.all([locker.lock('TEST-001'), locker.lock('TEST-002')]). Both per-task lock files can be acquired, but the final .anvil/state.json may contain only one of the two locked task records depending on write ordering.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The existing concurrency test only races multiple lockers for the same task ID, which exercises the per-task O_EXCL lock. It does not race successful locks for different task IDs that both write the shared state file.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a test that concurrently locks two or more different valid task IDs and asserts every successful lock has a corresponding entry in .anvil/state.json after all promises settle.
items.minimumFixScope: Protect updateTaskState/writeStateFile callers that mutate .anvil/state.json, especially TaskLocker.lock, unlock, and complete.

items.title: Task IDs are used as path segments without validation
items.recommendation: Validate task IDs before using them in paths, or encode task IDs into safe filenames. Reject path separators, '..', absolute paths, and platform-specific separators, and verify the resolved path remains under the expected locks or executions directory before writing or unlinking.
items.reproduction: Calling releaseLockFile(projectRoot, '../state') resolves the unlink target to projectRoot/.anvil/state.json because the computed path is projectRoot/.anvil/locks/../state.lock for lock helpers or analogous traversal for execution helpers. Variants with additional '..' segments can escape the .anvil subdirectories.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The lock-file tests cover normal IDs, duplicate acquisition, different normal task IDs, release, and same-task races, but no test passes path separators or traversal segments to the exported file helpers.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add tests for acquireLockFile, releaseLockFile, writeExecutionPlan, readExecutionPlan, and deleteExecutionPlan with task IDs containing '../', '/', and '\\', asserting they reject the ID and do not touch files outside the expected directory.
items.minimumFixScope: Centralise filename-safe task ID handling in getExecutionPlanPath and the lock-file path construction, then route all file operations through that validation.

items.title: Create output field does not match the documented JSON contract
items.recommendation: Either emit hashed_key to match the documented contract or update all consumers and documentation to use hashedKey. Prefer matching the existing comment unless the Pulumi component already consumes camelCase.
items.reproduction: Invoke the script with action create and valid environment variables, then inspect stdout; the JSON contains hashedKey rather than hashed_key.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided, and there is no visible assertion for the create stdout shape in the supplied files.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a script-level test for create stdout that asserts the exact JSON property names consumed by the Pulumi component.
items.minimumFixScope: Align the create stdout property name and add a contract test for the command output.

items.title: Concurrent creates can bypass the single active key check
items.recommendation: Enforce the invariant in the database with a partial unique index for active keys per actor, and handle the resulting conflict explicitly. If schema changes are outside this script's scope, take a transaction-scoped advisory lock keyed by actor_email or use SERIALIZABLE isolation with retry handling around the create transaction.
items.reproduction: Run two create processes concurrently with the same ACTOR_EMAIL and different BEARER_HEX values against an empty admin_keys table; both can pass the SELECT before either INSERT commits.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided for this feature, and the script has no visible concurrency test or database invariant test in the supplied files.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add an integration test that starts two create invocations for the same actor with different BEARER_HEX values and asserts that only one active admin_keys row exists and the losing invocation fails with a clear operator-actionable error.
items.minimumFixScope: Create path concurrency control plus a regression test around concurrent provisioning for one actor.

items.title: Domain import validation accepts import IDs for the wrong domain
items.recommendation: Parse the import ID, extract the trailing domain segment, and require it to exactly match the domainImports key before passing it to Pulumi.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The domainImports tests cover missing domain keys, malformed IDs, and the team-prefixed form, but not the case where a syntactically valid import ID names a different domain from the map key.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a test that domainImports: { 'www.example.com': 'prj_test123abc/other.example.com' } throws a clear mismatch error, plus a team-prefixed mismatch variant.
items.minimumFixScope: Tighten domainImports validation in VercelApp and add focused tests in vercel-app.test.ts.

items.title: Vercel ignore command interpolates path arguments without shell-safe quoting
items.recommendation: Build the ignore command with shell-safe escaping for every dynamic argument, or validate rootDirectory and extraWatchPaths with the same restrictive policy used for productionBranch. Also quote the git toplevel substitution when changing directories.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The tests cover productionBranch injection and simple path fragments such as apps/web, but they do not exercise rootDirectory or extraWatchPaths with spaces, quotes, or shell metacharacters.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add VercelApp tests that reject or correctly escape rootDirectory and extraWatchPaths values containing spaces, semicolons, command substitution, and single quotes.
items.minimumFixScope: Update defaultIgnoreCommand construction in VercelApp and extend vercel-app.test.ts coverage for path argument validation or escaping.

items.title: Empty authorship logs cannot round-trip through the serializer
items.recommendation: Either reject empty fileLineMap/empty attestations at creation and schema boundaries, or teach parseAuthorshipLog to accept a separator at the beginning of the content.
items.reproduction: Call serializeAuthorshipLog with { attestations: {}, metadata: validMetadata } and pass the result to parseAuthorshipLog. The parser throws 'missing --- separator'.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: serializer.test.ts round-trips only sample logs with at least one attested file, so the start-of-file separator path is not covered.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a serializer round-trip test for empty attestations if they are supported, or a createAuthorshipLog test that rejects an empty fileLineMap if they are not.
items.minimumFixScope: packages/anvil/core/src/provenance/git-ai-standard/serializer.ts and, if unsupported, packages/anvil/core/src/provenance/collector.ts validation.

items.title: Concurrent saves can lose index updates
items.recommendation: Serialise index updates with a lock file, or switch to an append-only/merge-on-write design that reloads and merges if index.json changed before rename.
items.reproduction: Start two Node processes that call ProvenanceStore.save against the same workspace. A possible final state is two record JSON files with index.statistics.total_checks incremented once and only one record listed.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: provenance.test.ts exercises only single-process sequential saves, so it cannot detect lost updates between processes.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a concurrency test using worker processes or child processes that save records simultaneously and assert the final index contains every saved record with matching statistics.
items.minimumFixScope: packages/anvil/core/src/provenance/store.ts index update path.

items.title: History retention trims only the index and leaves orphan record files
items.recommendation: When trimming index.records, unlink the evicted record files. clear should also remove all provenance record JSON files in historyDir, not just those currently listed in the index.
items.reproduction: Save 1001 records, inspect .anvil/history, then call clear. The evicted record file is not referenced by index.json and is not deleted by clear.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: provenance.test.ts saves only a handful of records and calls clear before any MAX_RECORDS eviction path is exercised.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a store test that saves MAX_RECORDS + 1 records, asserts the on-disk record count is capped, then calls clear and asserts no record JSON files remain.
items.minimumFixScope: packages/anvil/core/src/provenance/store.ts save trimming and clear cleanup logic.

items.title: Malformed Git AI notes are reported as missing
items.recommendation: Only convert the specific GitOperationError case for a missing note to null. Let parseAuthorshipLog errors propagate, or return a discriminated result that separates missing notes from corrupt notes.
items.reproduction: Create a git note under refs/notes/ai containing malformed JSON, then call readAuthorshipNote('HEAD', workspaceRoot). It returns null rather than failing with the parse/schema error.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: serializer.test.ts asserts parseAuthorshipLog throws on malformed content, but there are no git-notes tests proving readAuthorshipNote preserves those errors.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a readAuthorshipNote test that writes malformed note content and expects a parse/schema failure rather than null.
items.minimumFixScope: packages/anvil/core/src/provenance/git-ai-standard/git-notes.ts plus git-notes coverage.

items.title: OAuth state decoder accepts malformed base64url input as valid bytes
items.recommendation: Reject any encrypted state string that does not match a strict base64url pattern such as /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/ before padding and decoding.
items.reproduction: Call decryptState with an otherwise valid encrypted state token containing inserted whitespace. The current decoder does not reject it before atob, so acceptance depends on atob's permissive decoding rather than the function's base64url contract.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The garbled-input test uses a token that atob rejects outright. There is no test for non-canonical but atob-tolerated input such as embedded whitespace.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a decryptState test that inserts whitespace or another non-base64url character into a valid encrypted state token and expects null.
items.minimumFixScope: Tighten base64urlDecode validation and add a negative parser test.

items.title: /anvil routes are only de-indexed, not protected by the session cookie
items.recommendation: Add an explicit gate for /anvil and any private upstream proxy route, for example middleware or route-level handling that reads anvil-docs-session, calls verifyLicense, redirects unauthenticated users to /auth/login?next=<path>, and rejects invalid or expired tokens before any private content is served.
items.reproduction: Request /anvil/overview in a fresh browser session with no anvil-docs-session cookie. In the included app files there is no middleware, route handler, or proxy rule that redirects to /auth/login or validates the cookie for that path.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests cover helper functions only: BAUTH exchange, cookie parsing, JWT verification, next URL validation, and encrypted state. There is no route or middleware test asserting that /anvil requires a valid session cookie.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a route/middleware test that requests /anvil/overview without anvil-docs-session and expects a redirect to /auth/login?next=%2Fanvil%2Foverview, then repeats with a valid signed beta/pro/enterprise token and expects access to proceed.
items.minimumFixScope: Implement and test the /anvil access-control boundary in docs-shell routing/middleware.

items.title: ModuleStatusSchema rejects legacy statuses that the type contract says parsing accepts
items.recommendation: Either add a preprocessing/normalisation schema that accepts Draft and Complete and maps them to Proposed and Done, or narrow the comment so the exported schema's contract is explicit and direct consumers know legacy values must be normalised before validation.
items.reproduction: Call ModuleStatusSchema.safeParse('Draft') or ModuleStatusSchema.safeParse('Complete'); both return unsuccessful results despite the documented parse contract.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were included for this source group, and the feature metadata lists an empty tests array.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a types/schema test asserting that legacy module statuses are accepted through the intended public parsing schema and normalised to canonical ModuleStatus values, or asserting that direct ModuleStatusSchema rejects them if that is the intended contract.
items.minimumFixScope: Update the exported module status schema or its public documentation in packages/aps/src/types/index.ts, plus a focused schema regression test.

items.title: Build script points at a missing TypeScript config
items.recommendation: Change the build script to `tsc -p tsconfig.json`, or add and own a matching tsconfig.lib.json if the package intentionally separates build and typecheck configs.
items.reproduction: Run `pnpm -F @eddacraft/anvil-docs-meta build`; TypeScript will try to read tsconfig.lib.json rather than the existing tsconfig.json.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests exercise parser behaviour through Vitest, but they do not run the package build script or Nx build target.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a package-level build validation in CI for @eddacraft/anvil-docs-meta, or include this package in the existing workspace build check.
items.minimumFixScope: package.json build script or a new tsconfig.lib.json plus build validation

items.title: Parser accepts metadata tables that are not immediately after the H1
items.recommendation: Make collection stop at the first non-table/non-allowed trivial node after the H1, or explicitly validate that the first two relevant top-level nodes after the H1 are the metadata and relationships tables according to the convention.
items.reproduction: Parse markdown with `# Title`, then a paragraph, then the metadata table and relationships table. The current collectTablesAfterH1 loop will skip the paragraph and still accept both tables.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: Tests cover missing tables and malformed table columns, but not tables that exist later in the document after intervening non-table content.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a test where a paragraph or H2 appears between the H1 and metadata table and assert parseDocGovernance throws ParseError.
items.minimumFixScope: collectTablesAfterH1 behaviour plus a parser regression test

items.title: Freshness guard ignores the package manifest that controls native build outputs
items.recommendation: Include package.json in the freshness baseline, and consider checking generated index.js/index.d.ts presence or mtimes if those files remain build outputs required by the package entrypoints.
items.reproduction: Touch or edit package.json's napi.binaryName/targets or build flags without rebuilding while an existing .node is newer than src/Cargo.toml/build.rs/Cargo.lock; scripts/check-binding-fresh.mjs will not fail on that manifest change.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The existing package tests run after pretest, but none of the included tests exercises the guard with package.json newer than the native binding or asserts the set of freshness inputs.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a focused test for scripts/check-binding-fresh.mjs that creates a temporary package layout with package.json newer than a dummy .node and asserts the guard exits non-zero.
items.minimumFixScope: Update scripts/check-binding-fresh.mjs to include fileMtime(join(pkgDir, 'package.json')) in inputMtime, then add a guard regression test or documented fixture coverage.

items.title: Nx test target bypasses the Node-API contract tests
items.recommendation: Wire the Nx test target to run the package's Node test script, or add a separate Nx target for the Node-API contract tests and make the workspace/CI test pipeline depend on it.
items.reproduction: Run the Nx project test target for @eddacraft/anvil-checks-native; based on project.json it invokes @eddacraft/nxrust:test for package eddacraft-anvil-checks-napi rather than package.json's pretest/test scripts.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The Node tests cover the intended behaviours when run directly via pnpm --filter, but project.json does not route the workspace test target through those tests.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add an Nx target such as test:node or update test to execute pnpm --filter @eddacraft/anvil-checks-native test, then verify nx run @eddacraft/anvil-checks-native:test fails if one of the included __tests__ files is made failing.
items.minimumFixScope: Adjust .claude/worktrees/feat+usage-001/crates/anvil-checks-napi/project.json so the workspace test graph includes the package.json pretest and node --test contract suite.

items.title: Index APS files are detected but parsing only converts tasks
items.recommendation: Either implement explicit index-file parsing/mapping or lower detection/canImport behavior so index files are not claimed until the import path can preserve their module data.
items.reproduction: Use the index fixture shape from the detect test, call adapter.detect(content) and then adapter.parse(content). The detect result is true, but convertToAPSPlan has no module-to-plan mapping and only reads doc.tasks.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The tests assert index detection only. All parse tests use leaf specs under the Tasks section, so the detected Modules-section path is never parsed.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a parse test for a Modules-section index document that asserts the expected imported APSPlan shape, or asserts that index files are not detected/importable until supported.
items.minimumFixScope: APSMarkdownAdapter detection and parse conversion for Modules-section documents.

items.title: Detection ignores the H1 indicator and can select content that parse rejects
items.recommendation: Require an H1 for positive detection, or subtract/short-circuit confidence when hasH1Title is false so detect only claims content the parser can accept.
items.reproduction:
Call detect on `## Tasks

### AUTH-001: Implement login

**Intent:** Create login endpoint`; confidence is 65 from tasks, task pattern, and intent. Calling parse on the same no-H1 content should return PARSE_ERROR.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: Existing negative detection tests use regular markdown or SpecKit content. They do not test APS-like markers without the required H1 title.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a detect test for APS-like content missing the H1 title and assert detected is false, or add a detect-then-parse consistency test for positive detections.
items.minimumFixScope: APSMarkdownAdapter.calculateConfidence or detect gating around hasH1Title.

items.title: Export is advertised while serialize always returns NOT_IMPLEMENTED
items.recommendation: Implement serialize for APS markdown, or override canExport to return false for these formats until serialization is actually supported.
items.reproduction: Instantiate APSMarkdownAdapter, observe adapter.canExport('aps') is true, then call adapter.serialize(plan) and receive a NOT_IMPLEMENTED serialize error.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The tests stop at canExport and never call serialize for an APSPlan, so they verify the advertised capability but not the operation behind it.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a serialize test that passes a minimal APSPlan and asserts successful APS markdown output, or assert canExport is false while serialize remains unimplemented.
items.minimumFixScope: APSMarkdownAdapter.serialize and/or canExport capability reporting.

items.title: Advertised dogfood regression test is skipped by the linked command
items.recommendation: Either add the explicit ignored-test command to CI/feature metadata, or split out a smaller non-ignored dogfood smoke test that cargo test --workspace executes by default while keeping the full workspace walk as an explicit heavier job.
items.reproduction: Run cargo test --workspace and observe dogfood_ast_catalogue_on_anvil_crates is ignored; run cargo test -p eddacraft-anvil-checks-ast --test dogfood -- --ignored --nocapture to execute it.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The test containing these assertions is the intended coverage, but its #[ignore] attribute prevents the linked cargo test --workspace command from running it.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a CI or package script step that runs cargo test -p eddacraft-anvil-checks-ast --test dogfood -- --ignored, or add a non-ignored smoke test asserting the dogfood-critical parse-skip and false-positive buckets on a representative fixture set.
items.minimumFixScope: Update the crate test command/CI metadata or adjust the dogfood test split so the advertised command executes the intended coverage.

items.title: Registry load failures silently disable AST scanning
items.recommendation: Propagate registry loader warnings/failures into AstScanOutput, either by converting them to init_errors or by adding an explicit registry_errors/registry_warnings field that the CLI surfaces like AST query and predicate init failures.
items.reproduction: Call scan_bytes with AstScanOptions.registry_path pointing at an existing malformed registry JSON and a Rust file containing an AST-only violation such as panic!(). The result has no rule findings and no init_errors.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included dogfood test passes a valid workspace registry and only asserts init_errors is empty; it does not exercise a missing, unreadable, or malformed registry path.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a test that writes an invalid registry fixture, runs scan_bytes with registry_path set to it, and asserts that the output contains a surfaced registry load error rather than an empty clean scan.
items.minimumFixScope: crates/anvil-checks-ast/src/lib.rs load_rules/scan output handling plus a focused registry failure test.

items.title: Release publish target points at dist without any manifest generation step
items.recommendation: Either publish from the project root with main/types pointing at dist, or add an explicit build/package step that writes a correct package.json into dist before nx-release-publish and before release versioning touches the dist manifest root.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests exercise parser behavior only. They do not run the package build, inspect dist contents, or exercise nx-release-publish/versioning.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a release packaging check that runs the build target and asserts dist/package.json exists with the expected name, exports, main/types, and runtime dependencies before publish.
items.minimumFixScope: Adjust the build/release package-root configuration or add a manifest copy/generation step for dist.

items.title: Parser accepts governance tables that are not immediately after the H1
items.recommendation: Change table collection to inspect the immediate top-level nodes after the H1, allowing only ignorable whitespace as represented by the Markdown AST, and require the metadata table and relationships table to be consecutive table nodes in the expected positions.
items.reproduction: Parse markdown with '# Title', then an intervening paragraph or H2, then otherwise valid metadata and relationships tables. parseDocGovernance will return a result instead of throwing ParseError.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The tests cover missing tables and malformed tables, but every successful fixture places the tables directly after the H1; there is no negative fixture with valid tables later in the document after intervening content.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a test where valid metadata and relationships tables appear after a paragraph or H2 following the H1, and assert parseDocGovernance throws a ParseError mentioning immediate placement or missing metadata after H1.
items.minimumFixScope: Update collectTablesAfterH1 placement logic and add the negative parser fixture.

items.title: Named-pipe EOF is surfaced as an OS error despite the documented Ok(0) contract
items.recommendation: Map the expected pipe EOF condition, at least ERROR_BROKEN_PIPE and any other documented named-pipe EOF status used by this handle mode, to Ok(0). Keep other ReadFile failures as io::Error::last_os_error().
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included client/server test writes a payload and reads it back before shutdown; it never closes the server side before the client read, so the ERROR_BROKEN_PIPE path is untested.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a Windows test that creates an owner-only pipe server, connects a client, accepts the connection, drops or shuts down the server without writing, then asserts client.read(&mut buf) returns Ok(0).
items.minimumFixScope: OwnerOnlyPipeClient::read plus a focused Windows EOF regression test.

items.title: Pretest freshness guard can fail on stale platform-incompatible bindings
items.recommendation: Check the binding file that the package can actually load on the current platform, or filter .node candidates by the NAPI target suffix for process.platform/process.arch/libc before comparing mtimes. If the intended contract is that no stale target artifact may exist, add an explicit cleanup step before tests and make the error message identify the stale file.
items.reproduction: Place two .node files in the package directory: one current-platform binding newer than src/Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, and one other-target binding older than those inputs. Run `pnpm --filter @eddacraft/anvil-checks-native test`; the pretest guard fails because it uses the oldest .node file.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The feature metadata lists no linked tests, and the package test script runs the runtime tests only after this pretest guard, so there is no included test exercising multiple .node files with mixed mtimes.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a node:test for check-binding-fresh that creates a temporary package directory with a fresh current-target .node and an older non-current-target .node, then asserts the guard does not fail when only the non-current artifact is stale.
items.minimumFixScope: Update scripts/check-binding-fresh.mjs candidate selection and add a focused test or fixture for multi-artifact package directories.

items.title: Non-recursive loading silently overwrites duplicate module IDs
items.recommendation: Move the duplicate-ID check before both recursive and non-recursive insertion paths, or add the same modules.has(moduleId) ParseError guard to the non-recursive branch.
items.reproduction: Load an index containing two module headings with the same ID using { recursive: false }. The second modules.set call replaces the first module's metadata and graph entry instead of throwing.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The recursive=false test only verifies a valid index with unique module IDs and does not assert duplicate handling parity with recursive loading.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a duplicate-module index fixture and assert loadPlan(path, { recursive: false }) rejects with ParseError, matching recursive mode.
items.minimumFixScope: Add duplicate ID validation before non-recursive Map insertion and cover it with one loader regression test.

items.title: Root leaf specs with 'Modules ...' headings are loaded as empty indexes
items.recommendation: Apply the same disambiguation at the root level: after detectIndexFile, parse/probe the index and only call loadMultiModulePlan when the content is a real index with module entries; otherwise fall back to loadSingleFilePlan or make detectIndexFile require the actual APS index structure rather than a prefix match.
items.reproduction: Create a valid leaf APS document with tasks and an H2 named 'Modules impacted', then call loadPlan on it as the root file. The current root-level detection will classify it as an index before leaf parsing is attempted.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included false-positive test covers a leaf module referenced from an index, which exercises the nested fallback. It does not call loadPlan on a leaf spec with '## Modules impacted' as the root file.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a root-level leaf example containing '## Modules impacted' and assert loadPlan returns isMultiModule=false and preserves the leaf tasks.

items.title: Leaf metadata Tags and Dependencies keep empty and '(none)' entries

items.title: Inputs lists are tied to the final parsed field rather than their position
items.recommendation: Preserve field/list adjacency when parsing task content. Process the original ordered content array, or associate the first list immediately following an Inputs paragraph with that Inputs field instead of flattening paragraphs and lists into separate arrays.
items.reproduction:
Parse a task containing `**Inputs:**

- A
- B

**Expected Outcome:** Done`; parseTaskFields sees Expected Outcome after Inputs, lastField is no longer `Inputs`, inlineInputs is null, and the returned task has `inputs === undefined`.
items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included Inputs tests only place the input list at the end of the task and pass parseTaskFields a single paragraph plus a single list, so they never exercise a list-valued Inputs field followed by another field or preceded by another list.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add parseDocument and parseTask tests where `**Inputs:**` is followed by a list and then `**Expected Outcome:**` or `**Validation:**`, asserting both inputs and the later field are preserved.
items.minimumFixScope: Update parseTask/parseTaskFields input handling to retain ordered content context, then add focused parser tests for list-valued Inputs before later fields.

items.title: Task-level matches can disappear from context bundles when the parent module does not also match
items.recommendation: Keep parent modules for every retained task, or have the context bundle builders derive their module list from the filtered task set so every filtered task is represented exactly once. Apply the same rule consistently for task-level scope and tag filters.

items.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: Existing tag and scope tests use fixtures where matching module metadata and matching task metadata appear to align; context bundle tests only cover a scope where the expected module is present and do not assert that every filtered task appears in bundle.modules[].tasks.
items.suggestedRegressionTest: Add a fixture or synthetic LoadedPlan where a task-level tag or scope matches but its parent module metadata does not, then assert buildContextBundleJSON(filtered).summary.totalTasks equals the total number of tasks listed under bundle.modules.
